data.text/markdown: 1. The Tables

2. The Data

Generated by make_data.py, which writes CSVs into data/ from a fixed random seed. It deliberately breaks the "treatments can't exceed the appointment's length" rule in exactly two appointments (appointment_id 1 and 2), and deliberately includes 20 patients who were referred but never booked, and two treatments that are never given.
